claim: Every command the catalogue declares for the menu bar is rendered in it.
instrument: proctor_menu against the running app, read through real MCP stdio
app: app:45808:7 — the wave-9 .build/Proctor.app, Developer ID signed
instrumentNote: Enumerated while the app was not frontmost, the Window and Help menus come back unpopulated — five commands read as absent that are simply not built yet at that moment. The app is activated first, and that difference is the reason detector-defects says to suspect the instrument before the application.
spellingNote: The catalogue said 'Minimise' and AppKit supplies that item spelling it 'Minimize'. The repo writes British English where it chooses the words; this string is not Proctor's to choose, so the catalogue now records what the menu bar says.
